tei:div.tei:p: (35)e ma hoḥ dus dengs song snyigs ma'i mar zhabs da'ir/ las btsan pos mi 'dod bkri ba dang*/ don gong ltar bsam kyang chos ma mthun/ tshul ji ltar gleng kyang don sgo chung*/ snying nas chos zhig byed 'dod kyang*/ las ngan gyi mtsho chen ci yang rdol/ 'du 'ji 'dis rang gzhan mgo bo 'khor/ chos brgyad 'di 'ching ba dam che bas/ lnga bdo yi mchog dman su yang bslu/ chos byed la sman du lta ba dang*/ chos bshad sgrub kyi gos bzang gon 'dod kyang*/ nang ngan skyugs dang 'dra ba'i rtog pa 'dis/ lam rgyal ba mnyes pa dkon na snyam/ dus deng song gi bshad sgrub ro ltar mthong*/ gnas dben par bsdad kyang don ma byung*/ gzhan don gyi ltar snang chos pa dang*/ rang gzhan gyi blo rtsi cir yang bkra/ chos mdo sngags kyi tshongs zong 'phang med du/ 'jig rten 'di'i nor phyir btsong pa dang*/ tshe phyi ma'i las mtha' 'di ci 'gyur ram/ 'khor bu slob kyi skyong bran (36)byed byed nas/ don med du mi tshe zad pa dang*/ rnam g.yeng gi 'khor los nyin mtshan 'das/ pha bka' brgyud gong ma'i rnam thar la/ yid gting nas mos pa yod na yang*/ bar gcod kyi rkyen 'di tsam yang rdzu/ 'di snang 'di bslu thabs mkhas pas brid/ pha gong ma'i rjes su lus pa nga*/ sems snang g.yel che rung da phrug yin/ lus 'byung bzhi rgud pas sems pa skyo/ chos rgyud la ma 'byor snying rlung lang*/ bdag 'jin khur pos non pa dang*/ bdag med la ngal bso re na yang*/ sems ma rig 'thib pas lam mi shes/ blo phyin ci log la gom tshug 'khyor/ dbang med du dran phyir rgyug pa dang*/ ngo srung gyin ma zin re dogs mang*/ stan dgon gyi 'og 'jin 'di bdud kyi las/ bya byed 'di chu bo'i rlabs bzhin gnyer/ byed mang de mdo don ltor ba nga*/ grogs mang por 'grogs na 'thab la spro/ gnas dben par bsdad kyang yeng ma lam/ sa ma zin phyug po rlung khyer yin/

rang tshul nyid rang la gsang (37)pa dang */ phyi tshul 'chos bzang yang rang mgo bskor/ nang g.yo sgyu che rung ngan song rgyu/ sdig chen de chos la gsog pa yin/ chos bzang por re nas gzhan mgo bskor/ rang na tshod yad kyang 'chi ma dran/ chos med du lag stong 'gro ba nga*/ lam gshin rje'i 'jigs pa su yis skyobs/ 'jigs skyobs kyi kun slong sems la chag legs smon gyi dug chus myos pa dang*/ gzhan phan gyi bdud rtsis ma bran na/ chos byas tshad tshe 'di'i snon mar gda'/ da gang ltar bsam kyang rang sems la/ blo khel ba'i gtad so mi 'dug na/ sems nang du khug la gzhig 'grel thong*/ brgyud chos dang 'dres pa'i nyams len mjod/ nor bsags bsags rang la khyer dbang med/ 'dod srid kyi gsogs la dga' ba dang*/ thob nges pa sdig pa'i khur chen thob/ don med kyi khol po rgyug pa dang*/ chos brgyad kyi pho zo 'don pa 'di nga*/ lam phyi ma'i re ltos (38)ci zhig bgyid/ blo 'khrul pas bslus ste rang mgo rmongs/ don med pa'i chags sdang gsog pa dang*/ dgra mtha' med shes kyang brtul la brtson/ gnyen nges med go yang chags pas 'ching*/ zab rgyas kyi gol sa thob pa dang*/ bshad rol la mkhas pa snyem thag can/ 'di snang 'dis rtog pa'i mtho lugs sems/ tshig kha la khyer bas phan nam ltos/ rang tshul 'di drang por rtog dpyod rgyob/ don 'thad do snyam na nyams su longs/ yul ngan 'gro 'jigs pa'i dgra chen la/ nga mi 'jigs bsam na ci dgar rol/ zhes rang gis rang la smras pa dge/
